label: lifecycle-presence-and-metadata
sql: SELECT count(*),count_if(property_id IS NOT NULL OR entity_kind<>'edge' OR entity_version<>2 OR schema_revision<>'r1' OR source_epoch<>'e' OR source_position<>1 OR source_time_text<>'synthetic-structure:1' OR published_at IS NULL OR (operation='delete' AND (NOT old_present OR new_present OR old_json IS NULL OR new_json IS NOT NULL)) OR (operation='insert' AND (old_present OR NOT new_present OR old_json IS NOT NULL OR new_json IS NULL)) OR operation NOT IN ('delete','insert')) FROM client_dev.ashlar_composite_edges_20261005_q1.property_journal VERSION AS OF 2 WHERE source_feed='fixture-edge-structure'

columns.name: count_if((((((property_id IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT (entity_kind = edge))) OR (NOT (entity_version = 2))) OR (((NOT (schema_revision = r1)) OR (NOT (source_epoch = e))) OR (NOT (source_position = 1)))) OR ((((NOT (source_time_text = synthetic-structure:1)) OR (published_at IS NULL)) OR ((operation = delete) AND (((NOT old_present) OR new_present) OR ((old_json IS NULL) OR (new_json IS NOT NULL))))) OR (((operation = insert) AND ((old_present OR (NOT new_present)) OR ((old_json IS NOT NULL) OR (new_json IS NULL)))) OR (NOT (operation IN (delete, insert)))))))

label: tombstone-exact
sql: SELECT count(*),count_if(t.source_system IS DISTINCT FROM d.source_system OR t.type_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.rel_type_id OR t.id IS DISTINCT FROM d.id OR t.entity_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'edge' OR t.entity_version IS DISTINCT FROM 2 OR t.source_feed IS DISTINCT FROM 'fixture-edge-structure' OR t.source_epoch IS DISTINCT FROM 'e' OR t.source_position IS DISTINCT FROM 1) FROM client_dev.ashlar_composite_edges_20261005_q1.tombstone_r3 VERSION AS OF 1 t FULL OUTER JOIN client_dev.ashlar_composite_edges_20261005_q1.delete_r1 d ON t.source_system=d.source_system AND t.type_id=d.rel_type_id AND t.id=d.id

columns.name: count_if(((((NOT (source_system <=> source_system)) OR (NOT (type_id <=> rel_type_id))) OR ((NOT (id <=> id)) OR (NOT (entity_kind <=> edge)))) OR (((NOT (entity_version <=> 2)) OR (NOT (source_feed <=> fixture-edge-structure))) OR ((NOT (source_epoch <=> e)) OR (NOT (source_position <=> 1))))))
